nodes.label: composition 202609051340
nodes.reason: A WebGL canvas without preserveDrawingBuffer returns a fully transparent image when read outside a render frame, and it still encodes to a valid PNG that downloads happily. A blank file that looks like a successful save is worse than a refusal. And the print must fit the reader's paper rather than the one we assumed: size:auto with a flex column, not a forced A4 landscape with a fixed map height.

nodes.reason: The attribution bar clashed with the menus - on a 393x852 phone, opening EDIT drew Status Colours underneath it - so it moves into About, small print at the bottom, credit intact. File becomes the way into the mathematics the application runs on. Both additions are guarded to settle to no-ops: adoptLate runs from a MutationObserver, and an unconditional append inside one is a feedback loop that crashed the renderer under the arrival gate.

nodes.label: composition 202609042123
nodes.reason: One stylesheet rule in the menu-bar module hid the whole v8 SCADA layers panel with display:none!important whenever the bar was hosted, and its justification was circular: the rule made the panel's height never change, which was cited as proof the panel's own toggle was inert, which justified the rule. Measured live on v9.115 at 1400x900 and at an iPhone 13 viewport: all 60 engine layer switches present in the DOM and zero of 120 reachable without opening a menu, with the page unable to scroll to them. The register, the voltages, the supermarkets, the transit and the EV layers were all there and none could be touched. The rule is replaced with display:flex, the toggle is un-hidden, and the panel starts open on a desktop as v8 always did and collapsed on a phone where an open panel was measured holding 31.6 percent of the screen against the map's 29.3. The dropdowns are untouched; the Grid dropdown proxies the same original inputs the panel shows, so the two cannot disagree. The architect's instruction verbatim: restore v8 panels but keep dropdowns file, edit, scope, grid, about. And: do not lose the grid engines - so the arrival's measurement is proven against these same composed bytes by the hidden-tab and five-case arrival browser proofs before this generation ships.

nodes.label: composition 202609041957
nodes.reason: Cutting two generations in succession, where the second restamped only the cartridge holding the version ledger, left each cartridge's proof binding its generation to its own filename and its version to the live composition - so the arrival cartridge's proof asserted the current version against a manifest one generation behind it. The identities are not wrong so much as split, and split identity is the drift this tooling exists to stop. One cut brings them back together.
